purpose: Connect the validated legacy capitulum pattern-reduction structure to the preregistered FDT7 evolutionary model family while preserving the boundary between present structural adequacy and time-axis evidence.

legacy_simulation.claim_boundary: Prior-predictive structural sufficiency only; not posterior model probability, Bayes factor or causal proof.

changes_from_v1: replace single Cremanthodium orientation functional target with study-specific Cremanthodium and Polygonatum reproductive-fitness calibrations
add orientation between-study tau2 and I2 as context-heterogeneity diagnostics
time_axis_seed.orientation_function_boundary: Both direct manipulations favour the natural downward/nodding state for reproductive success, but effect magnitude is highly heterogeneous; no universal or Cirsium-specific fixed RR is assumed.

M0.name: neutral_or_unconstrained
M0.legacy_starting_point: ENV_ONLY plus neutral BM/Mk time-axis process

M2.name: single_biotic_driver
M2.legacy_starting_point: ENV_POLL or ENV_ANT depending preregistered agent

M3.name: common_lability
M3.legacy_starting_point: FULL_COUPLED_HET is the closest existing structural analogue because modules share a common lability component while ecological interaction regimes may vary

M4.name: modular_selection_mosaic
M4.status: preferred structural starting family, not yet time-axis winner

M5.name: modular_mosaic_plus_ecological_opportunity_pulse
M5.legacy_starting_point: FULL_MODULAR_HET plus dated event-window pulse layer

available_now: direct multi-trait pilot showing weak obligatory display-orientation-defence coupling
antagonist cost and display interaction heterogeneity

decision_rule_after_japan38: Use Japan38 module-transition counts and branch-overlap diagnostics as new posterior-predictive targets. Strong positive cross-module branch overlap favours the common-lability target family; weak or module-specific overlap combined with distinct ecological associations favours modular-mosaic targets. Neither outcome alone demonstrates adaptive or genetic modularity.
